head: iPhone 18 release date: spring 2027 with A20 chip, Gurman says
dek: The iPhone 18 and the cheaper iPhone 18e will come out in spring 2027 with Apple's A20 chip, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman; Apple hasn't announced either phone. He says the iPhone Air 2 is expected at the same time.
details: Gurman repeated the timing on his Power On podcast, in line with his earlier reports, according to MacRumors. There's no exact date, price or feature list beyond the chip.
means: If you were waiting for a regular iPhone 18 this fall, the report says it comes months later, in spring.
todo: Nothing to do yet. If you need a phone now, don't wait on a date Apple hasn't confirmed.
